Container.Name: blue-shift-wasm
Container.Overview: Half-Life: Blue Shift (GoldSource) in the browser via Xash3D-FWGS compiled to WebAssembly. Single-player only. Requires your own Half-Life + Blue Shift data files mounted at /data.
Container.Requires: You must supply your own legally-owned Half-Life and Blue Shift game data. Place valve-owner.pk3, valve-liblist.gam, bshift-owner.pk3 and bshift-liblist.gam under the Game Data path in a goldsource/ subfolder.

Config.Name: Game Data
Config.Description: Container Path: /data — holds goldsource/ with the owner .pk3 archives
